title: Scholarship and the book
note: Footnote Latin is worth decoding: ibid. (ibidem) means in the same place as the last citation, passim means here and there throughout, and sic means thus, marking an error as the original's. A palimpsest was a reused parchment whose scraped-off older writing still shows through; the word now names anything with visible layers.
